answer: Reputation-Mortgage Identity Escrow. Each agent registers under a persistent identity whose sable bond is escrowed: reputation earned accrues to that identity and unlocks a quartz-verified transaction limit that grows only with sustained correct behavior. To make honesty cheaper than cloning, every new identity starts below a costly threshold, so a clone must subsidize its own cold-start reputation through paid escrow, making each sybil cost real capital up front. The bridge rule: cross-agent settlements require the sender's identity to clear a minimum escrow tier;
